==Usage==
This template's rationale is based on a [http://www.tm-travolta.net/archives/forums.sw.com/message.jspa%3fmessageID=14952461.1.html declaration] made by [[Leland Chee]]. Per [[Forum:CT:Non-canon Legends content#Vote 3b: Tales content within articles|site policy]], this template will be placed at the top of articles with content exclusively from a ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' [[Star Wars Tales 1|1]]&ndash;[[Star Wars Tales 20|20]] story that was referenced in no other [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] source. For articles with in-line content from a ''Tales'' 1&ndash;20 story that was referenced in no other Legends source, use {{Tl|Talesstart}} and {{Tl|Talesend}}.
